title: Distribution of the Land East of the Jordan to Reuben, Gad and Half-Manasseh
description: Joshua has grown old, and the Lord reminds him that much land remains to be taken. The chapter describes how Moses earlier distributed the land east of the Jordan to the tribes of Reuben, Gad and half-Manasseh, with detailed borders and cities from the conquered kingdoms of kings Sihon and Og. The tribe of Levi receives no land inheritance, for the Lord himself is their inheritance.
